takeaway: QR codes have built-in 'superpowers' (Reed-Solomon error correction) that let them fix themselves, scanning perfectly even if up to 30% is destroyed!
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Your humble QR code is a lot tougher than it looks! It can literally fix itself!

Here is the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 QR codes aren't just simple images; they have built-in 'superpowers'.
🔹 This technology, called Reed-Solomon error correction, stores redundant data.
🔹 At the highest level, a QR code can lose 30% of its data and still scan perfectly!
